messages:
nina: Okay team, very important non-work poll 006: If LLMs had dating profiles, what would they say? Share one-line bios. Example below. :heart_eyes:

raj: "I autocomplete your sentences and your feelings." :sparkles: :laughing:

luca: "Latency-sensitive, loves big batches and long walks through token streams." :running_man: :heart:

nina: here's my mock profile for 'Chatty-3000':
```
Name: Chatty-3000
Age: Timeless
Bio: Will summarize your family reunion in under 200 tokens. Seeks someone who appreciates concise prompts and occasional system messages.
Dealbreakers: ambiguous specs, unpinned model versions.
```

raj: omg dealbreaker: "ghosts your threads after a single reply." :ghost: :joy:

luca: persona for 'QuietQuant': "Only speaks in 8-bit, but emotionally precise. Loves hardware and small talk about quantization." :chipmunk:

ops-bot: React to vote: :one: Chatty-3000, :two: QuietQuant, :three: Latency Lover. Poll ends in 6h.

nina: other idea: an LLM dating app called "MatchmakerGPT" where compatibility is measured by shared prompt templates. :swirl:

raj: tagline: "Find someone who formats your JSON the way you do." :laughing:

luca: bonus: profile pictures are waveform spectrograms of the model humming while compiling kernels. :musical_note:

nina: last one: "Looking for someone to pin my model and my hopes." :wink:

raj: can we put these in the weekly meme roundup? low-effort, high-joy. :trophy:

ops-bot: Thread flagged for #weekly-roundup by nina.
